verses.sloka: राघवेणाभये दत्ते सन्नता रावणानुजः ।विभीषणो महापाज्ञो भूमिं समवलोकयन् ।खात्पपातावनीं हृष्टो भक्तैरनुचरैः सह ।। ६.१९.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghaveṇābhaye datte sannatā rāvaṇānujaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇo mahāpājño bhūmiṁ samavalokayan ।khātpapātāvanīṁ hṛṣṭo bhaktairanucaraiḥ saha ।। 6.19.1 ।।।।

translations.english: When wise Vibheeshana, the brother of Ravana was assured of security by Raghava, he looked around the ground and prepared (to descend).

verses.sloka: स तु रामस्य धर्मात्मा निपपात विभीषणः ।पादयोः शरणान्वेषी चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः ।। ६.१९.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu rāmasya dharmātmā nipapāta vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।pādayoḥ śaraṇānveṣī caturbhiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ ।। 6.19.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Righteous Vibheeshana descended from the sky and fell at the feet of Rama accompanied by his devotees happily (considering it to be inappropriate to come with foot down he came straight down with his body).

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं वाक्यं तत्र विभीषणः ।धर्मयुक्तं च युक्तं च साम्प्रतं सम्प्रहर्षणम् ।। ६.१९.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca tadā rāmaṁ vākyaṁ tatra vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।dharmayuktaṁ ca yuktaṁ ca sāmprataṁ sampraharṣaṇam ।। 6.19.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Vibheeshana and the four Rakshasas who sought shelter prostrated lying at the feet of Rama expressing their duty, duly and placing confidence in Rama who spoke these words showing extreme joy.
translations.hindi: आकाश से अपने भक्तिभाव रखने वाले चार संत्रियों को लिए हुए, हर्षित हो प्रथिवी पर आए ओर धर्मात्मा विभीषण श्रीयसचन्द्र जी के चरणों मं गिर पड़े॥ पादयोः शरणान्येपी चतुमि; सह राक्षस । अन्नवीच्च तदा राम वाक्यं सत्र विभीषणः

verses.sloka: अनुजो रावणस्याहं तेन चाप्यवमानितः ।भवन्तं सर्वभूतानां शरण्यं शरणागतः ।। ६.१९.४ ।।४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anujo rāvaṇasyāhaṁ tena cāpyavamānitaḥ ।bhavantaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇāgataḥ ।। 6.19.4 ।।4 ।।।।

translations.english: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."
translations.hindi: त्रिभीषण ने यक्तियुक्त, घमसङ्गत और तत्काल मन को अत्यंत प्रसन्न करने बाले वचन श्रीरामचंद्र जी से कहे। वे बोल--महाराज ! मैं रावण का छोटा भाई हूँ । उसने मेरा अनादर किआ है

verses.sloka: परित्यक्ता मया लङ्का मित्राणि च धनानि वै ।भवद्गतं मे राज्यं च जीवितं च सुखानि च ।। ६.१९.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: parityaktā mayā laṅkā mitrāṇi ca dhanāni vai ।bhavadgataṁ me rājyaṁ ca jīvitaṁ ca sukhāni ca ।। 6.19.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Leaving Lanka, my friends and my wealth I came to you. Now my life, kingdom and welfare are at your disposal."
translations.hindi: आप प्राणीमात्र के रक्षक है । अतः मैं लङ्का में मित्रों को और समस्त घन सम्पत्ति को त्याग कर, आपके शरण में आया हूँ

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत् ।वचसा सान्त्वयित्वैनं लोचनाभ्यां पिबन्निव ।। ६.१९.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāmo vacanamabravīt ।vacasā sāntvayitvainaṁ locanābhyāṁ pibanniva ।। 6.19.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: अब तो मेरा राजपाट, जीवन और सुखादि समस्त ही आपके अधीन है। विसीषण के ये वचन सुन श्रीरामच द्र जीने कहा

verses.sloka: आख्याहि मम तत्त्वेन राक्षसानां बलाबलम् ।। ६.१९.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ākhyāhi mama tattvena rākṣasānāṁ balābalam ।। 6.19.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: हे रास, उसका सेनापति प्रहरत हैं। शायद तुमने उसका नाम सुना हो ! उसी के द्वारा केज्ञास पवत पर अणिभद्र हराया गया था

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तदा रक्षो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।रावणस्य बलं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ६.१९.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastadā rakṣo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।rāvaṇasya balaṁ sarvamākhyātumupacakrame ।। 6.19.8 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasa (Vibheeshana) having heard that Rama of unwearied action would save him proceeded to speak out about the strength of Ravana.

verses.sloka: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां गन्धर्वासुररक्षसाम् ।राजपुत्र दशग्रीवो वरदानात् स्वयम्भुवः ।। ६.१९.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ gandharvāsurarakṣasām ।rājaputra daśagrīvo varadānāt svayambhuvaḥ ।। 6.19.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Prince, by virtue of a boon granted by Brahma, the selfborn to the tenheaded Ravana, he cannot be killed by Gandharvas, Rakshasas and by all beings."

verses.sloka: रावणानन्तरो भ्राता मम ज्येष्ठश्च वीर्यवान् ।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः शक्रप्रतिबलो युधि ।। ६.१९.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇānantaro bhrātā mama jyeṣṭhaśca vīryavān ।kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ śakrapratibalo yudhi ।। 6.19.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "My elder brother, the one who is younger to Ravana is a highly valiant one endowed with great prowess. He is Kumbhakarna and equal to Indra in war."
translations.hindi: न्‌ ~ बड ण aa A नं“ ं्एएएंणशांं र # पाठान्तरे--“गन्धर्वासुरर्षसान्‌। ? अथवा “गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिणां ।” Dl था आन अक क्ल see एक[नावराः सगः १५१ ` रावण से छोटा और मुझसे बड़ा मेरा सकचा भाई कुंभकरण बड़ा बलवान और तेजस्वी है और युद्ध में इन्द्र का सामना कर सकता हे

verses.sloka: राम सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो यदि वा श्रुतः ।कैलासे येन सङ्ग्रामे मणिभद्रः पराजितः ।। ६.१९.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāma senāpatistasya prahasto yadi vā śrutaḥ ।kailāse yena saṅgrāme maṇibhadraḥ parājitaḥ ।। 6.19.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rama You might have heard of Prahastha who the commander in chief of his (Ravana's) army is by whom Manibhadra (Kubera's Commander of Army) was defeated in a comb at in Kailas (the abode of Siva)."

verses.sloka: बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणस्त्ववध्यकवचो युधि ।धनुरादाय यस्तिष्ठन्नदृश्यो भवतीन्द्रजित् ।। ६.१९.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇastvavadhyakavaco yudhi ।dhanurādāya yastiṣṭhannadṛśyo bhavatīndrajit ।। 6.19.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "He (Ravana's eldest son) who is possessed of Iguana skin on his hands (to protect), and with a shield that cannot be pierced and who remains unseen in comb at wielding a bow is Indrajith."
translations.hindi: गोह के चमड़े के दस्ताने पहन, कवच धारण कर और धनुष लेकर संग्राम करते-करते अदृश्य हो जाने वाला इ द्रजीत मेघनाद है

verses.sloka: सङ्ग्रामसमयव्यूहे तर्पयित्वा हुताशनम् ।अन्तर्धानगतः शत्रूनिन्द्रजिद्धन्ति राघव ।। ६.१९.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṅgrāmasamayavyūhe tarpayitvā hutāśanam ।antardhānagataḥ śatrūnindrajiddhanti rāghava ।। 6.19.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "Raghava Indrajith strikes when caught by a network of foes in war by becoming invisible because of satisfying fire god."
translations.hindi: हे राघव ! ये बड़ी-बड़ी लड़ाइयों में जहाँ बड़े-बड़े व्यूहों की , रचना हुआ करती है, हवन द्वारा अग्निगेव को तृप्त कर, अन्तद्वीन हो शत्रुओं को मारा करता हे

verses.sloka: महोदरमहापार्श्वौ राक्षसश्चाप्यकम्पनः ।अनीकस्थास्तु तस्यैते लोकपालसमा युधि ।। ६.१९.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahodaramahāpārśvau rākṣasaścāpyakampanaḥ ।anīkasthāstu tasyaite lokapālasamā yudhi ।। 6.19.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mahodara, Mahaparsva, Akampana are Rakshasas who are like the guards of the world. They are the commanders of his (Ravana's) army."
translations.hindi: इनके अतिरिक्त रावण के सेनापति महोदर, महापाशव श्रकम्पन नामक राक्षस ऐसे हैं, जो युद्ध भें लोकपालों जैसा पराक्रम प्रदर्शित किआ करते हैं

verses.sloka: दशकोटिसहस्राणि राक्षसां कामरूपिणाम् ।मांसशोणितभक्षाणां लङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम् ।। ६.१९.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: daśakoṭisahasrāṇi rākṣasāṁ kāmarūpiṇām ।māṁsaśoṇitabhakṣāṇāṁ laṅkāpuranivāsinām ।। 6.19.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thousands of Rakshasas inhabit the city of Lanka living on flesh and blood and changing their form at will."

verses.sloka: स तैस्तु सहितो राजा लोकपालानयोधयत् ।। ६.१९.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taistu sahito rājā lokapālānayodhayat ।। 6.19.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "The unassailable rulers of the world and even celestial beings have been shattered by Ravana accompanied by the Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: उन सब को साथ ले महाबली दावण ने लोकपालों से युदूध क्रिया था और देवताओं सहित इनको परास्त किया था

verses.sloka: सह देवैस्तु ते भग्ना रावणेन महात्मना ।। ६.१९.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saha devaistu te bhagnā rāvaṇena mahātmanā ।। 6.19.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama of mighty prowess having heard everything from Vibheeshana, examining in his mind, spoke.

verses.sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रामो दृढपराक्रमः ।अन्वीक्ष्य मनसा सर्वमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१९.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāmo dṛḍhaparākramaḥ ।anvīkṣya manasā sarvamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.19.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana Those actions resorted to by Ravana which have been spoken by you in essence are known to me."
translations.hindi: हः AS ९ प ते ् हे विभीषण ! रावण के ज्ञिन-जिन कमो का तुमने बखान भ्र ~ किश्ा, वे सब मुझको यथाथरीत्या विदित हैं

verses.sloka: यानि कर्मापदानानि रावणस्य विभीषण ।आख्यातानि च तत्त्वेन ह्यवगच्छामि तान्यहम् ।। ६.१९.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāni karmāpadānāni rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇa ।ākhyātāni ca tattvena hyavagacchāmi tānyaham ।। 6.19.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "By Killing the tenheaded Ravana along with Prahastha and relatives I will make you the king. I am telling you, this is true."

verses.sloka: अहं हत्वा दशग्रीवं सप्रहस्तं सबान्धवम् ।राजानं त्वां करिष्यामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते ।। ६.१९.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ hatvā daśagrīvaṁ saprahastaṁ sabāndhavam ।rājānaṁ tvāṁ kariṣyāmi satyametad bravīmi te ।। 6.19.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even if Ravana enters the hell or underground or the abode of Brahma the creator, I will not let him be alive."
translations.hindi: रावण प्राण बचाने को चाहे रसातल में जाय, चाहे पाताल में अथवा ब्रह्मा जी के पास ही क्यों न भाग कर चला जाय, पर वह अब जीता नहीं बच सकता

verses.sloka: रसातलं वा प्रविशेत् पातालं वापि रावणः ।पितामहसकाशं वा न मे जीवन् विमोक्ष्यते ।। ६.१९.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṁ vā praviśet pātālaṁ vāpi rāvaṇaḥ ।pitāmahasakāśaṁ vā na me jīvan vimokṣyate ।। 6.19.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "I vow upon my three brothers that I will not enter Ayodhya without putting an end to Ravana along with his people, sons and relatives."
translations.hindi: PL (G मैं अपने तीनों भाइयों की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ कि, युद्ध में पुत्र, सेना और भाईबम्दों सहित रावण को मार बिना, में अयोध्या में पैर न खखूंगा

verses.sloka: अहत्वा रावणं सङ्ख्ये सपुत्रबलबान्धवम् ।अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्रिभिस्तैर्भ्रातृभिः शपे ।। ६.१९.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahatvā rāvaṇaṁ saṅkhye saputrabalabāndhavam ।ayodhyāṁ na pravekṣyāmi tribhistairbhrātṛbhiḥ śape ।। 6.19.22 ।।।।

translations.english: After having heard the words of Rama of untiring in action, Vibheeshana of righteous nature, started to speak with his head bent down (in reverence).

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य धर्मात्मा वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। ६.१९.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।śirasā ' 'vandya dharmātmā vaktumevopacakrame ।। 6.19.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."

verses.sloka: राक्षसानां वधे साह्यं लङ्कायाश्च प्रधर्षणम् ।करिष्यामि यथाप्राणं प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वाहिनीम् ।। ६.१९.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ vadhe sāhyaṁ laṅkāyāśca pradharṣaṇam ।kariṣyāmi yathāprāṇaṁ pravekṣyāmi ca vāhinīm ।। 6.19.24 ।।।।

translations.english: When Vibheeshana had spoken in that manner, Rama was pleased and embraced him. He called for Lakshmana to get water from the ocean (for consecration).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार वचन कहते हुए विभीषण को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने अपनी छादी से लगा लिआ्रा और लक्ष्मण से कहा कि, जाओ समुद्र से जल ले आओ । मैं विभीषण पर प्रसन्न हू

verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवाणं रामस्तु परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् ।अब्रवील्लक्ष्णणं प्रीतः समुद्राज्जलमानय ।। ६.१९.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: iti bruvāṇaṁ rāmastu pariṣvajya vibhīṣaṇam ।abravīllakṣṇaṇaṁ prītaḥ samudrājjalamānaya ।। 6.19.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "I am pleased with this highly intelligent Vibheeshana, a respectable one. I will coronate him at once as king of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: तेन चेमं महाप्राज्ञमभिषिञ्च विभीषणम् ।राजानं रक्षसां क्षिप्रं प्रसन्ने मयि मानद ।। ६.१९.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena cemaṁ mahāprājñamabhiṣiñca vibhīṣaṇam ।rājānaṁ rakṣasāṁ kṣipraṁ prasanne mayi mānada ।। 6.19.26 ।।।।

translations.english: (Rama) having spoken that way, Saumithri crowned Vibheeshana as crowned king on the command of Rama amid Vanara army chiefs.
translations.hindi: समुद्रजल से इन महावुद्धिंमान्‌ विभीषण को शीघ्रही राक्षसा के राजसिंहासन पर अभिषिक्त करने का मेरा बिचार है । में इनके व्यबहार से सन्तुष्ट हूँ ओर इनका बहुमान करू गा शी एवयुक्तस्तु सौमि त्रिरभ्यपिश्चडि भीषणम्‌ । मध्ये वानरशुख्यानां राजानं रामशासनात्‌

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्रिरभ्याषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् ।मध्येवानरमुख्यानां राजानं राजशासनात् ।। ६.१९.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu saumitrirabhyāṣiñcadvibhīṣaṇam ।madhyevānaramukhyānāṁ rājānaṁ rājaśāsanāt ।। 6.19.27 ।।।।

translations.english: At that instant the Vanaras jumped, moving about exhibiting their joy on witnessing great Rama's grace saying "Good, good."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को प्रसन्नता का इस प्रकार का तुरन्त फल मिला हुआ देख, वानरों ने हषनाद किआ और वे “साधु साधु” कहने लगे

verses.sloka: तं प्रसादं तु रामस्य दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्लवङ्गमाः ।प्रचुक्रुशुर्महात्मानं साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन् ।। ६.१९.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ prasādaṁ tu rāmasya dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।pracukruśurmahātmānaṁ sādhu sādhviti cābruvan ।। 6.19.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman and Sugriva enquired of Vibheeshana as to how to cross this ocean that is imperturbable along with the entire lot of energetic Vanara army.
translations.hindi: सुग्रीव और हनुमान ने विभीषण से कहा--मित्र! अब यह तो बतलाओ कि, हम लोग इस अक्षोभ्य वरुणालय अर्थात्‌ समुद्र के बड़े-बड़े पराक्रमी वानरो की समस्त सेना सहित क्यों कर पार हों ? हमारी समझ में तो ऐसा कोई उपाय नहीं आ रहा हे) जिससे हम समस्त सेना सहित समुद्र पार हो सक । जब दोनों बानर-श्रेष्ठों ने इस प्रकार कहा, तव धर्मज्ञ विभीषण ने उत्तर देते हुए कहा

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च हनूमांश्च सुग्रीवश्च विभीषणम् ।। ६.१९.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca hanūmāṁśca sugrīvaśca vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.19.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "What strategy should we adopt to cross this abode of Varuna, the Lord of rivers and streams with the entire army of Vanaras?" (Hanuman and Sugriva asked Vibheeshana).

verses.sloka: कथं सागरमक्षोभ्यं तराम वरुणालयम् ।सैन्यैः परिवृताः सर्वे वानराणां महौजसाम् ।। ६.१९.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ sāgaramakṣobhyaṁ tarāma varuṇālayam ।sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇāṁ mahaujasām ।। 6.19.30 ।।।।

translations.english: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."

verses.sloka: उपायं नाधिगच्छामो यथा नदनदीपतिम् ।तराम तरसा सर्वे ससैन्या वरुणालयम् ।एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मज्ञः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.१९.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: upāyaṁ nādhigacchāmo yathā nadanadīpatim ।tarāma tarasā sarve sasainyā varuṇālayam ।evamuktastu dharmajñaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.19.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "This immeasurable great ocean was excavated by Sagara (A King of the Ikshvaku dynasty). The great ocean needs to do the task of Rama who is of the same race."
translations.hindi: महाराज श्रीरामचन्द्र, समुद्र के शरण में जाँय--यही उपाय है। श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पूर्वपुरुष महाराज सगर द्वारा खुदवाए जाने के कारण ही इसका नाम सागर पड़ा है, सो यह अथाह जल वाला

verses.sloka: समुद्रं राघवो राजा शरणं गन्तुमर्हति ।। ६.१९.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: samudraṁ rāghavo rājā śaraṇaṁ gantumarhati ।। 6.19.32 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana having spoken in that manner, Sugriva accompanied by Lakshmana reached near Rama.
translations.hindi: , 7 22 # पाठान्तरे- “ज्ञात्वा काय महामतिः । १५६ A सब वाळ का ४ काम अवश्य करेगा । जब | ने इस प्रकार कहा

verses.sloka: र्वे ससैन्या वरुणालयम् ।खानितः सगरेणायमप्रमेयो महोदधिः ।कर्तुमर्हति रामस्य ज्ञात्वा कार्यं महामतिः ।। ६.१९.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rve sasainyā varuṇālayam ।khānitaḥ sagareṇāyamaprameyo mahodadhiḥ ।kartumarhati rāmasya jñātvā kāryaṁ mahāmatiḥ ।। 6.19.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter broadnecked Sugriva started to communicate to Rama the advice of Vibheeshana about Sagara.

verses.sloka: एवं विभीषणेनोक्तो राक्षसेन विपश्चिता ।आजगामाथ सुग्रीवो यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।। ६.१९.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ vibhīṣaṇenokto rākṣasena vipaścitā ।ājagāmātha sugrīvo yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 6.19.34 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.
translations.hindi: मोटी गर्दनबाले प्रीय ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से समुद्र की उपासना करने को कहा । धर्मात्मा शीरामचन्द्र जी को भी यह बात अच्छी जान पड़ी

verses.sloka: ततश्चाख्यातुमारेभे विभीषणवचः शुभम् ।सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सागरस्योपवेशनम् ।। ६.१९.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataścākhyātumārebhe vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śubham ।sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ sāgarasyopaveśanam ।। 6.19.35 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.

verses.sloka: प्रकृत्या धर्मशीलस्य राघवस्याप्यरोचत ।। ६.१९.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyā dharmaśīlasya rāghavasyāpyarocata ।। 6.19.36 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana This advice of Vibheeshana is pleasing to me. Sugriva is learned, and you are always capable of good advice. That which appeals to both of you, and which is meaningful may be informed to me."
translations.hindi: महातेजस्वी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ले स्वयं बह काय करने की शक्ति रखते हुए भी, विभीषण के कथन का आदर करते हुए मुसक्‍या कर लक्ष्मण ओर सुग्रीब से कहा ॥३४)। विभीषशस्व मन्त्रीञ्य मथ सन्म रोचते। व्र हि त्व सहसुग्रीबस्तवापि यदि रोचते

verses.sloka: स लक्ष्मणं महातेजाः सुग्रीवं च हरीश्वरम् ।सत्क्रियार्थं क्रियादक्षः स्मितपूर्वमुवाच ह ।। ६.१९.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaṁ mahātejāḥ sugrīvaṁ ca harīśvaram ।satkriyārthaṁ kriyādakṣaḥ smitapūrvamuvāca ha ।। 6.19.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Heroic Rama having said that way to both, Lakshmana and Sugriva replied thus respectfully following tradition (with folded hands).

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्य मन्त्रो ऽयं मम लक्ष्मण रोचते ।ब्रूहि त्वं सहसुग्रीवस्तवापि यदि रोचते ।। ६.१९.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasya mantro 'yaṁ mama lakṣmaṇa rocate ।brūhi tvaṁ sahasugrīvastavāpi yadi rocate ।। 6.19.38 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Raghava, the tiger among kings Why will this good advice given to us at this time by Vibheeshana be not pleasing?" Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama."
translations.hindi: र्ग शो ES त ` जद श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन दोनों बीर सुग्रीव ऑर लक्ष्मण से इस प्रकार पूं छा, तब हाथ जोड़ कर वे बोले !

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवः पण्डितो नित्यं भवान् मन्त्रविचक्षणः ।उभाभ्यां सम्प्रधार्यार्थं रोचते यत्तदुच्यताम् ।। ६.१९.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvaḥ paṇḍito nityaṁ bhavān mantravicakṣaṇaḥ ।ubhābhyāṁ sampradhāryārthaṁ rocate yattaducyatām ।। 6.19.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Without building a bridge over this terrific ocean, the abode of Varuna, it is not possible to cross over to Lanka even for Indra, suras or Asuras.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तौ तु तौ वीरावुभौ सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ ।समुदाचारसंयुक्तमिदं वचनमूचतुः ।। ६.१९.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktau tu tau vīrāvubhau sugrīvalakṣmaṇau ।samudācārasaṁyuktamidaṁ vacanamūcatuḥ ।। 6.19.40 ।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि इस भयानक समुद्र पर पुल बाँचे विना इन्द्रसहित सुर और असुर भी लङ्का सें नहीं पहुँच सकते

verses.sloka: किमर्थं नौ नरव्याघ्र न रोचिष्यति राघव ।विभीषणेन यच्चोक्तमस्मिन् काले सुखावहम् ।। ६.१९.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṁ nau naravyāghra na rociṣyati rāghava ।vibhīṣaṇena yaccoktamasmin kāle sukhāvaham ।। 6.19.41 ।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

verses.sloka: अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुं घोरे ऽस्मिन् वरुणालये ।लङ्का नासादितुं शक्या सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ।। ६.१९.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abaddhvā sāgare setuṁ ghore 'smin varuṇālaye ।laṅkā nāsādituṁ śakyā sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ ।। 6.19.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Then when they (Sugriva and Lakshmana) said so to Rama, he sat on Kusa grass mat on the shore of the ocean just as fire stayed in the sacrificial altar. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the nineteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: । इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी वेदी के बीच भें स्थापित अग्नि की तरह समुद्र के तट पर कुश बिला कर बैठ गए

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्य शूरस्य यथार्थं क्रियतां वचः ।अलं कालात्ययं कृत्वा समुद्रो ऽयं नियुज्यताम् ।यथा सैन्येन गच्छामः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ।। ६.१९.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasya śūrasya yathārthaṁ kriyatāṁ vacaḥ ।alaṁ kālātyayaṁ kṛtvā samudro 'yaṁ niyujyatām ।yathā sainyena gacchāmaḥ purīṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।। 6.19.43 ।।।।

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तः कुशास्तीर्णे तीरे नदनदीपतेः ।संविवेश तदा रामो वेद्यामिव हुताशनः ।। ६.१९.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ kuśāstīrṇe tīre nadanadīpateḥ ।saṁviveśa tadā rāmo vedyāmiva hutāśanaḥ ।। 6.19.44 ।।
